title: Automatic evaluation of atlantoaxial subluxation in rheumatoid arthritis by a deep learning model
summary: A CNN keypoint model measures atlanto-dental interval and spinal-cord space from RA cervical X-rays and is evaluated against clinicians on held-out images; this is a specific diagnostic measurement result.
